dct_title_s: Bremer County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol SR; form of individual image numbering: SR-1-[number], SR-2-[number], SR-3-[number], or SR-4-[number]."Date of completion 08-09-37" Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
